title: Entangled Backpack
subtitle: The buffer, carried
text:
Write a code onto the Entangled Backpack in the Ender Programmer, the same way as a Link Card. Right click with it to open the Entangled Buffer slots on that code from anywhere, in any dimension.

Each open uses 1000 FE from its own 50k FE battery. Charge it in the Charger.

The Programmer's Private button applies to the backpack too: a private backpack opens only its owner's private buffers. Backpacks cannot be put inside a buffer.
caption: Two buffers, one inventory
